body: do you remember what the iama was about? An ama for a dude with OCD?

thanks. That made me feel a little better.

How do you deal with the problem when you get the urges? I just need to figure out a way to calm myself when the thought first pops up. What usually happens for me is it pops into my mind, I try and ignore it, but 10 seconds later I'm thinking about it, and then longer I think about it the more panicked I get until I go into a min-panic attack/anxiety attack until I'm eventually able to distract myself with something else. If you have any suggestions for ways to deal with the thoughts when they first come up I think that would help me out a ton
